title: Deception and Communication in Autonomous Multi-Agent Systems: An Experimental Study with Among Us
reasoning: The paper explores deception as a strategic capability within a game-based multi-agent environment. While deception is a moral behavior, the study focuses on the linguistic and tactical mechanics of communication (using speech act theory and interpersonal deception theory) rather than evaluating or benchmarking the agents against religious values, formal moral reasoning, or ethical frameworks.
